description: This file is a PHP source file for a Jira REST API interface implementation in the Issue Tracker integration of the TestLink project. It contains code to connect to Jira, retrieve issue data, and display configuration information and test outputs.

classes.name: jirarestInterface
classes.description: A class handling the interaction with Jira's REST API for issue tracking purposes.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Checks if the connection to the Jira API is successful.

methods.name: getAPIClient
methods.description: Returns an API client object for further direct API interactions.

methods.name: getIssue
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific Jira issue.
